_comment: Real cases from the 2026-08-30 production audit
(scripts/audit_period_assignment.py, read-only run against the live DB).
`stored_period_end` / `period_end_hint` are what the DB actually holds —
every mismatch has hint == stored, which is the proof that the frontend
wrote the DROP TARGET's date into the human-confirmation channel.
`expected_proposed_period_end` is what a hint-free detection service must
propose from the document's OWN evidence; null means ABSENT (no signal),
which must force an explicit human choice and must never become today.

cases.note: The reported case. A 2025 file was dropped on the open 2017 period.
